title: Research (stage output)
description: What the research stage hands to later stages, stored in job.outputs.research.data. It points at the client's insight sheet and carries a copy of its downstream block, so brief, concept, hooks, script, localise and shot sourcing read it without opening the insight record.

research_status.description: fresh = an existing sheet was reused; partial = the unattended part is fresh but the browser step is still queued; refreshed = an older sheet was updated now; new = the first sheet for this client; skipped = urgent job, nothing ran.

insight_id.description: The insight sheet used. Null only when skipped and the client has no sheet yet.

insight_version.description: Version of the insight sheet copied into downstream.

insight_date.description: When that sheet was created, so readers can judge its age.

flags.description: no_fresh_research = the brief must say research is old or missing; browser_step_pending = the Instagram read is queued; widened = the niche was too small and research widened to category or city.

note.description: One line for the brief, e.g. 'Urgent job: research skipped; using the October sheet (54 days old).'

downstream.description: Copy of the insight's downstream block at insight_version. Empty lists when skipped with no sheet.
